parameters.content:
### WhatsApp Message Receiver & AI Agent Router

**Functions & Features:**
- **WhatsApp Trigger**: Native n8n WhatsApp messages trigger node.
- **IF - Message Filter**: Ignores Meta status notifications silently to keep logs clean.
- **Inbound Type Router**: Differentiates between text messages and interactive list choices.
- **List Reply Router**: Intercepts Retailer/Painter list option clicks and returns CTA URL buttons with high-quality headers.
- **User Type Router**: Sends image welcomed lists to Retailers/Painters, URL buttons to Customers, and executes DSE/DSO AI Agent logic.
